rowActions.name: Name

pathPicker.truncated: Showing the first {count} matches. Narrow the search to see the rest.
pathPicker.treeUnreadable: The repository tree could not be read. Try again in a moment.

createItemDialog.title: Add a test case
createItemDialog.description: A test you want on this checklist that generation did not propose.
createItemDialog.featureHint: The grid groups by feature. An existing name files this test alongside the others; a new one starts a new group.
createItemDialog.testNamePlaceholder: e.g., Rejects an expired reset token
createItemDialog.expectedResultHint: What a correct implementation should do, specifically. Not what it currently does — that is the result a tester records.
createItemDialog.kindHint: Negative means the feature should refuse something — bad input, a missing permission, an expired token.

itemGrid.generatingDescription: A generation is running. The test cases appear here when it finishes.
itemGrid.emptyDescription: Generate the checklist, or add one by hand.
itemGrid.testCaseCount: {count, plural, one {# test case} other {# test cases}}
itemGrid.editDescription: What it is called, what it should do, and why it exists. The recorded result is not editable here.
itemGrid.deleteDescription: The test case and the result recorded against it both go.

changeSetPanel.title: Proposed changes
changeSetPanel.skipped: {count, plural, one {# proposed change was} other {# proposed changes were}} skipped because the test case they referred to no longer exists.
changeSetPanel.discardDescription: Discard these proposals? Nothing will be written to the checklist.

chatPanel.sharedDescription: Everyone on this instance can read this conversation.

moduleScreen.mockDataDescription: Sample records for {path}, grounded in its actual schema.

exportScreen.description: Download a project's test checklist, its mock data, or both, for every module or the ones you choose.
exportScreen.projectCap: Showing the first {count} projects by name.
exportScreen.includeHint: One part downloads as a spreadsheet; both download together as a .zip. Mock data has a sheet per module, after a cover sheet listing every module exported.

exportScreen.moduleCap: Showing the first {count} modules by name. Choose All modules to export every one.
